blocks.title: Electrolytic cell
blocks.text: Electrolytic cell woh aala (device) hai jo electrolysis naami amal se bijli ki energy ko kimiyai energy mein badalta hai. Is mein do electrodes hote hain, aam taur par metal ya kisi aur conductor ke, jo electrolyte mein doobe hote hain, aise madde mein jis mein azad ions hon jo bijli ka current le jate hain.

Jab direct current lagaya jaye to ek electrode manfi charge wala (cathode) aur doosra musbat (anode) ban jata hai. Electrolyte ke musbat ions cathode ki taraf jate hain, jahan woh electrons hasil karte hain (reduction), jabke manfi ions anode ki taraf, jahan woh electrons khote hain (oxidation). Ions ki yeh harkat aur electrons ki muntaqili electrodes par kimiyai tabdeeliyan paida karti hai, bijli ki energy ko kimiyai energy mein badalte hue. Electrolytic cells sodium chloride ki electrolysis se sodium metal aur chlorine gas banane, metals ko saaf (refine) aur plate karne, aur caustic soda jaise chemicals banane mein istemal hote hain; electrolysis chlorine jaise non-metals bhi banati aur metals saaf karti hai.

Figure 10.1 ke electrolysis cell mein electrolyte woh compound hai jo toota jata hai, ya to pighla hua ionic compound ya ions ka ghaliz (concentrated) aabi solution; electrodes, carbon (graphite) ya metal ke, electrolyte tak aur us se bijli le jate hain, anode musbat electrode aur cathode manfi; aur power supply direct current honi chahiye. Cell ki asal banawat nikale jane wale element ke mutabiq badalti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: DC supply wala cell jis ka surkh anode (+) aur neela cathode (-) pighle zinc chloride mein doobe hain; chloride ions anode ki taraf aur zinc ions cathode ki taraf jate hain, neeche half-equations aur kul muadla. Oopar daen: Q = I x t, Faraday aur lead ke liye Sample 10.5. Neeche daen: copper electrolysis ka tajurba jo 0.13 g copper ke liye 408 C aur Avogadro's constant 6.2 x 10^23 deta hai.
blocks.caption: Electrolytic cell, bijli ki miqdar aur electrolysis se Avogadro's constant (Figures 10.1 aur 10.2 aur topics 10.6 se 10.10.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Direct current ek electrode ko manfi cathode aur doosre ko musbat anode banata hai. Zn2+ jaise cations cathode tak ja kar metal mein reduce hote hain; Cl- jaise anions anode tak ja kar chlorine mein oxidise hote hain, to pighla zinc chloride zinc aur chlorine mein toot jata hai. Guzra hua charge current zarb waqt hai, aur ek Faraday, 96500 coulombs, ek mole electrons ka charge hai, to ek mole lead ko do Faradays chahiye aur 1800 coulombs 1.93 gram jama karte hain. Yeh naap kar ke maloom charge anode se kitna copper hatata hai, fi mole copper charge milta hai, aur use ek electron ke charge par taqseem karna Avogadro's constant deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Supply direct current kyun honi chahiye, aur musbat ions kis electrode par jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Electrolysis ko muqarrar cathode (manfi) aur anode (musbat) chahiye taake cations hamesha ek taraf aur anions doosri taraf jayein; alternating current electrodes ko second mein kai baar ulat deta aur koi kul tootna jama na hota. Musbat ions manfi cathode ki taraf jate hain, jahan woh electrons hasil karte hain.
